title: PRD sign-off choreography for Private Deployment upgrade flow
creator: Emily Chen
description: Coordinate cross-team PRD review and sign-offs for the Private Deployment Upgrade Flow (zero-downtime patching, version pinning, KMS rotation). This ticket defines the choreography for reviews between Product, Engineering, Design, and Legal; captures scope clarifications that surfaced during early discovery; and establishes concrete acceptance criteria and handoff artifacts required before starting implementation on the private runtime package.
context: Private customers have asked for a safer in-place upgrade experience that preserves telemetry, supports customer-defined KMS keys, and allows controlled rollouts across on-prem fleets. The current PRD (v0.7) contains open questions on RBAC scoping, upgrade rollback semantics, and E2E telemetry required for SLA reporting. Multiple teams must sign off to avoid rework in implementation and to ensure compliance posture is met for regulated customers.
scope_changes: Added KMS key rotation workflow and explicit customer-managed key section (was previously out of scope).
Narrowed UX surface: postpone per-node UI until post-MVP to reduce design/QA lift.
Clarified rollback semantics: soft-fail + automatic revert in case of KV cache mismatch rather than forceful abort.
decisions_needed: Legal: confirmation on required audit log retention period for private upgrades (30 vs 90 days).
Engineering: agreement on default rollback timeout and whether to expose adjustable parameter in the Console.
Design: alignment on in-UI migration status indicators and error states copy for customer-facing dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Product: PRD v1.0 published in Confluence with a changelog and explicit 'out-of-scope' section.
Engineering: runbook and upgrade playbook created in the Private repo and reviewed by infra oncall; two unit/integration tests covering rollback path added to CI.
Design: annotated screens for Console rollout UX with error states and accessibility checks reviewed in Figma; readiness flagged in design review thread.
Legal: signed confirmation on audit retention requirements, data residency notes, and sample contract clause for upgrades appended to PRD.
Security: KMS rotation design reviewed and 'security_review_required' checklist completed by Security team.
All stakeholders: explicit sign-off comments in the PRD page (Confluence) with name + date.
updates: 2025-03-11 - Emily Chen: Created ticket and uploaded PRD draft v0.7. Requested initial alignment meeting with Eng/Design/Legal.
2025-03-12 - Raj Patel: Pulled runtime constraints into engineering response doc; proposed default rollback timeout = 120s.
2025-03-13 - Sofia Martinez: Shared two alternative UI flows in Figma; recommended simplifying to single progress bar + detailed logs view.
2025-03-14 - Julien Becker: Legal requested 90-day audit retention for certain regulated customers; asked for customer opt-in language for shorter retention.
notes: Plan a 60-minute alignment session with concrete agenda: 1) outstanding legal requirements, 2) rollback semantics decision, 3) Console UX confirmation, 4) CI/runbook acceptance checklist.
If Legal mandates 90-day retention, estimate storage cost impact and add to PRD risk section with sample numbers.
Blockers: need SRE verification on rollback safety for clusters with mixed old/new kernel versions.
